"""Main's serialized real host lifetime/fault checks; no GPU qualification."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/feat-phase-cache-stock-bench-20261013')
T = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.tools/intel-llvm-v711/install')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('phase_host_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(O) == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'


def dump(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    prior = json.loads((B / 'main-upstream-benchsh-quiet-copy0-launch-root-v1/record.json').read_text())
    assert prior['passed'] and prior['complete'] and not prior['active']
    assert all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0 for c in prior['commands'])
    out = B / 'main-phase-cache-host-check-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, main_reviewed=True,
        gpu_executed=False, model_executed=False, commands=[], evidence={},
        production_admitted=False, phase_cache_adopted=False)

    def save():
        dump(out / 'record.json', r)

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    env = dict(PATH=str(T / 'bin') + ':/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8',
        LC_ALL='C.UTF-8', LD_LIBRARY_PATH=str(T / 'lib'), PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')

    def run(label, argv, selected_env=None):
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, selected_env or env, W, wall=180, cpu=1200,
            rss_cap=3 << 30, text_cap=2 << 20, total_cap=16 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0, label

    try:
        sources = ['CMakeLists.txt', 'include/strata/core/phase_cache_owner.hpp',
            'include/strata/core/phase_serve_cycle.hpp', 'include/strata/core/phase_timing.hpp',
            'src/core/phase_cache_owner.cpp', 'tests/core/phase_cache_owner_test.cpp',
            'serve/server.py', 'serve/test_server.py']
        r['source_pins'] = {name: m.sha(W / name) for name in sources}
        save()
        common = ['/usr/bin/cmake', '-S', str(W), '-G', 'Ninja', '-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release',
            '-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=' + str(T / 'bin/clang++'), '-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=' + str(T / 'bin/clang'),
            '-DSTRATA_LICENSE=free', '-DSTRATA_ENABLE_XE=OFF', '-DSTRATA_BUILD_TESTS=ON',
            '-DSTRATA_CUDA_ARCHS=', '-DSTRATA_HIP_ARCHS=', '-DSTRATA_ONEMKL=OFF',
            '-DSTRATA_WERROR=ON', '-DSTRATA_PORTABLE=OFF', '-DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON',
            '-DSTRATA_GGML_DIR=/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/.worktree/dep-ggml-3cf-xe-e32-20261011']
        for name, extra in [('phase-host', []), ('phase-host-asan', ['-DSTRATA_SANITIZE=address,undefined'])]:
            build = W / 'build' / name
            assert not build.exists()
            run('configure-' + name, common + ['-B', str(build)] + extra)
            run('build-' + name, ['/usr/bin/cmake', '--build', str(build), '--parallel', '2', '--target', 'phase_cache_owner_test'])
            test_env = dict(env)
            if extra:
                test_env.update(ASAN_OPTIONS='detect_leaks=1:halt_on_error=1',
                    UBSAN_OPTIONS='halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1')
            run('ctest-' + name, ['/usr/bin/ctest', '--test-dir', str(build), '-R', '^phase_cache_owner_test$', '--output-on-failure'], test_env)
            r[name] = dict(binary_sha256=m.sha(build / 'phase_cache_owner_test'),
                compile_commands_sha256=m.sha(build / 'compile_commands.json'), release_ndebug=True,
                sanitizer='address,undefined' if extra else None)
            save()
        run('server-phase-lifetime', ['/usr/bin/python3', '-m', 'unittest', 'serve.test_server.PhaseExperimentLifetime', '-v'])
        run('server-suite', ['/usr/bin/python3', '-m', 'unittest', 'serve.test_server', '-v'])
        for name, digest in r['source_pins'].items():
            assert m.sha(W / name) == digest
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True,
            scope='Actual CPU owner bookkeeping/lifetime/fault orchestration, Release NDEBUG, host ASan/UBSan and HTTP phase lifetime; no GPU/VMM/backend/model qualification')
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'error', 'scope')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
